question: opencode-zen-free: do the verdict fails-identity and free_tier.unit unlimited rest on what the opencode.ai/docs/zen page says?
why: the page says 'Free-tier chat models require OpenCode; use paid models or Go from other clients' and that an API key needs billing details and credits, which is a client restriction and not a named identity gate, and each free model is described as free on OpenCode for a limited time with no quota figure, so unit unlimited is unsupported; the record is outside this unit's scope
